title: procedure wrong
why: When the technician contradicts the procedure itself, the answer is to file a defect, not to coach them through a step that does not physically exist on this machine.

step.title: Fit the new pads and torque the caliper bolts
step.explanation: An under-torqued caliper bolt backs out under braking heat and the caliper moves. This is the step that kills someone if it is skipped.

fields.prompt: Torque both caliper bolts to spec and record the reading

input.transcript: There's no lower bolt on this one. It's the sliding pin type, always has been. Whoever wrote this was looking at the older model.
